notes: QUTCC uses calibrated quantile queries with median anchoring; no multiplicative interval scale. The default is minimum-calibration-width asymmetric search with simultaneous HB bounds. Equal-tail fixed-sequence search is reported separately. Other models retain separate lower/upper RCPS scales. 2048 calibration images; 5000-image held-out QUTCC comparison. Display averages use only 50 manifest-ordered examples. Target coverage is 90%, not exactly 90% per image. All metrics and bounds clipped to [0,1].

calibration.confidence_policy: Bonferroni: delta/2 per tail, joint failure <= delta

im2im.notes: First 50 held-out test images in manifest order; not full-test aggregates. RCPS independent lower/upper scaling, alpha=.1, delta=.05. Clipped [0,1]. QUTCC native q=.05/.95 followed by scale calibration, not quantile-query calibration. MC p=.1 and 30 passes fixed before test; final validation-selected policy is pending. Width need not equal absolute error. Image-level coverage is not guaranteed to be 90%.

selection.policy: Minimum calibration mean width among simultaneously HB-certified quantile pairs. Bonferroni across all endpoint candidates; total tail-risk UCB <= alpha. No fixed tail allocation or q-gap. No test selection.

conditioned.endpoint_policy: Clipped quantile predictions anchored to the median: LB=min(Q(q_lower),Q(.5)), UB=max(Q(q_upper),Q(.5)); no interval multiplication. Global q pair per camera, spatially varying predicted bounds.
conditioned.selection_policy: 36 endpoint candidates fixed before calibration, 324 pairs; simultaneous image-level HB UCBs with delta/36. Select minimum calibration width subject to sum of tail-risk UCBs <= .1. Test labels never used in selection.
conditioned.limitation: Finite-grid search, not a continuous global optimum. Simultaneous search certificate is more conservative than the old two-tail scaling certificate. Guarantees require independent calibration images and matching calibration/test distribution. Weights unchanged; median reconstruction unchanged.
